baseline: sequential climatology (running Laplace-smoothed base rate; secondary constant 0.5). Calibration must beat it to mean anything.
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect=none, 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73101..73105} (never used before), PredictionLog JSONL per seed, canonical derive_seed streams. 1950 ticks pooled per domain.
hypothesis: Architecture B's §30 stated uncertainties are calibrated probabilistic claims: on all four domains the Brier score beats sequential climatology and the reliability curve sits near the diagonal.
interpretation: FINDING (negative): B's §30 stated uncertainties are MISCALIBRATED on all four domains — they fail to beat climatology everywhere. D1 next_obs: Brier 0.2532 vs climo 0.2508 (skill -0.009), ECE 0.048 but MCE 0.909 (high-confidence bin p≈1.0 observed 0.09). D2 action_consequence: 0.2866 vs 0.2505 (skill -0.144), under-confident (S=-0.19; stated reward uncertainty systematically too large). D3 competence_failure: 0.1025 vs 0.0734 (skill -0.398), over-confident (S=+0.17; failure over-predicted ~3x in the main bin). D4 retrieval_usefulness: 0.2610 vs 0.2472 (skill -0.056), dispersion error (observed benefit rate flat ~0.40-0.47 across predicted 0.08-0.64). Root cause: stated uncertainty is essentially uncoupled from actual error magnitude — corr(sigma,|err|) = 0.02 (D1/D3), 0.17 (D2), 0.05 (D4). The Gaussian predictive claim is the tested object; per the preregistered abstention rule no thresholds/bins/mappings were tuned after the run. Consequence: B's confidence outputs are not decision-usable as probabilities; the CalibrationTracker slope/bin summaries remain descriptive only.
limitations: Single env (changing_rule), closed-loop policy conditions the visited distribution; affect=none matches BAR/K1 characterization conditions. Gaussian bridge tests the full probabilistic claim (Gaussian + stated sigma), not sigma alone. corr(sigma,|err|) supplementary metric shows the uncoupling directly, independent of the bridge.
null_hypothesis: Brier_B >= Brier_climo on every domain (stated uncertainties carry no probabilistic information beyond the base rate).
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_B vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology); ECE/MCE over 10 bins; signed error S. CALIBRATED iff Brier_B<Brier_climo AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25; MISCALIBRATED iff Brier_B>=Brier_climo or reliability off-diagonal; UNMEASURABLE on degenerate gates. Thresholds frozen pre-run from 2340 published ticks (EPS_OBS=0.2682, EPS_RW=0.2067, TAU_FAIL=0.4156); no post-run tuning.

next_obs.verdict: MISCALIBRATED (fails to beat climatology; dispersion error)

retrieval_usefulness.verdict: MISCALIBRATED (fails to beat climatology; dispersion error)
